title: Russian Glide Bomb Strikes Civilian Buses Near Kramatorsk, Killing At Least 30
detail: A Russian glide bomb attack targeted buses carrying Ukrainian civilians near the Kramatorsk frontline in the Donetsk region, killing at least 30–33 people in one of the largest single-incident civilian mass-casualty events in recent months. The strike hit civilian evacuation or transit vehicles in close proximity to the front, drawing immediate international condemnation.

title: Ukraine Drone Attack Sets Yandex Data Centre on Fire Inside Russia
detail: A Ukrainian drone attack struck and set fire to a Yandex data centre inside Russia, marking a significant strike on Russian tech infrastructure. The attack demonstrated Ukraine's continued capability to reach deep into Russian territory and target economically significant facilities.

title: Türkiye Warns Black Sea Must Not Become New Front in Russia-Ukraine War
detail: Türkiye issued a warning that the Black Sea must not be allowed to become a new front in the Russia-Ukraine war, reflecting growing concern over naval escalation following recent Ukrainian strikes on Russian maritime assets. Ankara, which controls the Bosphorus and Dardanelles under the Montreux Convention, reiterated its role as a key stakeholder in preventing Black Sea destabilization.

title: India and Türkiye Advance New Proposals to Broker Russia-Ukraine Truce
detail: India and Turkey put forward new diplomatic proposals aimed at brokering a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, intensifying mediation efforts. The dual-track initiative reflects growing international pressure to end the conflict as both nations position themselves as viable neutral mediators between the warring parties.
